recordingSettings.ffmpegDescription: Fileship records with FFmpeg. Download the tested build or point to your own.
recordingSettings.notInstalledDescription: Screen and GIF recording need it. The download is about 110 MB.
recordingSettings.videoDescription: How screen recordings are captured and encoded.
recordingSettings.captureMethodDescription: Desktop Duplication runs on the GPU and keeps up with high frame rates. Areas that span several monitors always use GDI.
recordingSettings.webmVideo: WebM only holds VP9 or AV1 video. Pick one of those encoders.
recordingSettings.showBorder: Show a border around the area
recordingSettings.showBorderDescription: The border and the controls never appear in the recording.
recordingSettings.presetX26x: Faster presets use less CPU and make bigger files.
recordingSettings.presetNvenc: p1 is the fastest, p7 the best quality.
recordingSettings.presetAmf: How much the GPU works for quality.
recordingSettings.presetQsv: Faster presets keep the GPU free for other work.
recordingSettings.presetVp9: CPU usage level. Higher is faster.
recordingSettings.audioDescription: Record your microphone, the sound your computer plays, or both at once.
recordingSettings.microphoneDescription: Your voice or any other input device.
recordingSettings.noiseSuppressionDescription: Filter out fans, keyboards and background hum.
recordingSettings.echoCancellationDescription: Remove your speakers from the microphone when you do not use headphones.
recordingSettings.autoGainControlDescription: Keep your voice at a steady level.
recordingSettings.systemAudioDescription: Everything you hear: videos, games, calls and notifications.
recordingSettings.tracksSingle: One track with the source you turned on.
recordingSettings.tracksMixed: One track with your microphone and system audio together.
recordingSettings.tracksSeparate: Your microphone and system audio in their own tracks, so you can edit them apart.
recordingSettings.tracksBoth: A mixed track for playback, plus one track per source for editing.
recordingSettings.gifDescription: GIFs are recorded losslessly first, then converted with an optimized palette.
recordingSettings.advancedDescription: Extra FFmpeg arguments and the full command.
recordingSettings.outputArgsDescription: Added before the output file of every recording.
recordingSettings.commandDescription: Recorded for the primary monitor with your current settings.
